versions.name: Camp Lynn
versions.summary: A rustic Mountaineer Area Council camping facility near Camp Mountaineer south of Morgantown, West Virginia, with wooded hills, natural streams, and primitive sites suited to backpacking and troop camping.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified against the Mountaineer Area Council's own Camp Lynn page and the Camp Mountaineer site map, which references Camp Lynn as a separate MAC property. Council confirmed as Mountaineer Area (matches the source hint); de-duped against the existing wv-camp-mountaineer record, which is a distinct nearby property. Coordinates from scout-camp-map, approximate; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence and council verified; distinct from Camp Mountaineer. camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a primitive/troop-camping property; features unsurveyed.
